name: Alpha-GPC
summary: Alpha-GPC is a nootropic substance belonging to the Choline derivative chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Alpha-GPC breaks down into two key components, choline and glycerophosphate. Choline and its metabolites are needed for three main physiological purposes: structural integrity and signaling roles for cell membranes as well as cholinergic neurotransmission (acetylcholine synthesis). This process essentially allows acetylcholine to accumulate at higher levels than it otherwise would.

uses.text: When taken as a supplement, this compound has nootropic effects which may have the potential for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and other related disorders. It is easily available and commonly sold for this purpose via online supplement and nootropic vendors.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include headache, nausea, heartburn, diarrhoea and trouble sleeping. Some research has raised a question about a possible link with stroke risk in people taking it long term, which is not settled.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括頭痛、噁心、胃灼熱、腹瀉與睡眠困難。有研究提出長期服用者的中風風險可能相關的疑問，但此事尚無定論。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括头痛、恶心、胃灼热、腹泻与睡眠困难。有研究提出长期服用者的中风风险可能相关的疑问，但此事尚无定论。

fact.en: Alpha-GPC occurs naturally in milk and in soya, and it is also found in the human brain, where it is part of the normal turnover of cell membranes.
fact.zh: Alpha-GPC 天然存在於牛奶與大豆中，也存在於人腦，是細胞膜正常代謝循環的一部分。
fact.zhHans: Alpha-GPC 天然存在于牛奶与大豆中，也存在于人脑，是细胞膜正常代谢循环的一部分。
